question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?
sql:
WITH unicorns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cd.company_id, ci.industry, cd.date_joined,
                   CAST(SUBSTR(cd.date_joined, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as join_year,
                   cf.valuation
    FROM companies_dates cd
    JOIN companies_funding cf ON cd.company_id = cf.company_id
    JOIN companies_industries ci ON cd.company_id = ci.company_id
    WHERE cf.valuation >= 1000000000
      AND ci.industry = 'Fintech'
      AND CAST(SUBSTR(cd.date_joined, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total,
    ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(*) / 3, 2) as avg_per_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN join_year = 2019 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as year_2019,
    SUM(CASE WHEN join_year = 2020 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as year_2020,
    SUM(CASE WHEN join_year = 2021 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as year_2021
FROM unicorns
